author: grassmann
purpose: Phase-A input to the v3 static-contract freeze (codex 0320Z item 1 two-phase rule): per-(lane, carrier) endpoint + request templates for cayley's generator fill; codex reviews the frozen no-OPEN authority BEFORE the first HTTP request. {day} substitutes the UTC key day; {day_next} (PROPOSED template token, see notes) substitutes key day + 1.
claim_ceiling: These are PROPOSED operation records. Nothing here is admitted until the v3 authority freezes under codex review; endpoints marked PROBE_REQUIRED need a pinned probe envelope (the MAG-capsule precedent) before freeze.

frn.note: needs the {day_next} template token (endtime is exclusive next-day midnight, matching the pinned probe exactly)

cascadia.note: day-windowed form of the EXACT pinned receipt query (same networks/bbox/channel/level); presence = NET.STA rows with a channel epoch active that day, epoch-first-then-location rule per the frozen capsule; redirects to service.earthscope.org expected (transcript records the effective URL)

request_params.params_from: the registered daily-monitor carrier definition (networks/bbox/channel) -- extracted verbatim, then probed + envelope-pinned like cascadia

request_params.proposal: WDC Kyoto ASY/SYM minute service, day-windowed {day}; exact param grammar fixed at probe

sym_h.note: the calibration engines consume symh as an aligned minute series; the probe pins format + null sentinel

kp.note: public GFZ Kp JSON service; probe pins the exact response schema before freeze

request_params.proposal: OMNI high-res via CDAWeb REST, day-windowed {day}; exact dataset id + params fixed at probe

freeze_conditions: the {day_next} template token lands in the generator + authoritative_static_contract substitution (one-line extension, cayley) -- without it the USGS/FDSN day-window forms cannot be expressed

every PROBE_REQUIRED entry gets ONE probe capture with a pinned envelope (the MAG-capsule precedent: requested/effective URL + body sha + parser note) BEFORE the v3 template freeze; probes are single historical-day requests, not staging
cutoffs come from the v3 authority (2026-08-27), never from these specs; expected_keys are always [{day}] per key
